description: Live, structured data from 50+ specialized providers in one call. Call this tool whenever an answer depends on facts that change over time or that you should not state from memory. A few examples among many more: market and crypto prices, wallets and DeFi, company records and financials, SEC filings, patents, clinical trials and drug safety, scientific papers, news, prediction markets, packages and CVEs, flights, weather. When no specialized provider fits, it falls back to web search, so it can replace a generic web search on any question. KIRHA plans the query, calls the right providers (SEC, PubMed, CoinGecko, GitHub, Polymarket and more) and returns each provider's raw result. Ask in plain language, there is nothing to configure.

focus.description: Optional vertical slug that restricts the search to one vertical. Leave it out unless the user asks for a specific vertical, since the search already covers all of them. Slugs are listed at https://discovery.kirha.com/verticals/list.mdx.

query.description: The question to answer. Be specific: name the asset, company, place or period it is about.
